H7400.def: from «07402» a scandal-monger (as travelling about):--slander, carry tales, talebearer.

H7401.def: a primitive root; to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively:--(be) faint((-hearted)), mollify, (be, make) soft(-er), be tender.

H7402.def: a primitive root; to travel for trading:--(spice) merchant.

H7403.def: from «07402»; merchant; Rakal, a place in Palestine:--Rachal.

H7404.def: feminine passive participle of «07402»; trade (as peddled):--merchandise, traffic.

H7406.def: from «07405»; a mountain ridge (as of tied summits):--rough place.

H7407.def: from «07405»; a snare (as of tied meshes):--pride.

H7408.def: a primitive root; to lay up, i.e. collect:--gather, get.

H7409.def: from «07408»; a relay of animals on a post-route (as stored up for that purpose); by implication, a courser:--dromedary, mule, swift beast.

H7410.def: active participle of «07311»; high; Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite:--Ram. See also «01027».

H7411.def: a primitive root; to hurl; specifically, to shoot; figuratively, to delude or betray (as if causing to fall):--beguile, betray, (bow-)man, carry, deceive, throw.

H7412.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07411»; to throw, set, (figuratively) assess:--cast (down), impose.

H7413.def: feminine active participle of «07311»; a height (as a seat of idolatry):--high place.

H7414.def: the same as «07413»; Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine:--Ramah.

H7415.et: from (07426) in the sense of breeding [compare (07311)]
H7415.def: from «07426» in the sense of breading (compare «07311»); a maggot (as rapidly bred), literally or figuratively:--worm.

H7416.def: or rimmon {rim-mone'}; from «07426»; a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament):--pomegranate.

H7417.def: or (shorter) Rimmon {rim-mone'}; or Rimmownow (1 Chronicles 6:62 («077»)) {rim-mo-no'}; the same as «07416»; Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine:--Remmon, Rimmon. The addition "-methoar" (Josh. 19:13) is ham-mthonar {ham-meth-o-awr'}; passive participle of «08388» with the article; the (one) marked off, i.e. which pertains; mistaken for part of the name.

H7418.et: from the pl. or construct form of (07413) and (05045)
H7418.def: or Ramath Negeb {raw'-math neh'-gheb}; from the plural or construct form of «07413» and «05045»; heights (or height) of the South; Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb, a place in Palestine:--south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.

H7420.et: from an unused root meaning to hurl
H7420.def: from an unused root meaning to hurl; a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point:--buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.

H7422.def: from «07311» and «03050»; Jah has raised; Ramjah, an Israelite:--Ramiah.

H7423.def: from «07411»; remissness, treachery:--deceit(- ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.

H7424.def: of foreign origin; a brood mare:--dromedary.

H7425.et: from an unused root and (03050) (perhaps meaning to deck)
H7425.def: from an unused root and «03050» (perhaps meaning to deck); Jah has bedecked; Remaljah, an Israelite:--Remaliah.

H7426.def: a primitive root; to rise (literally or figuratively):--exalt, get (oneself) up, lift up (self), mount up.

H7427.def: from the active participle of «07426»; exaltation:--lifting up of self.

H7428.def: from «07416» and «06556»; pomegranate of the breach; Rimmon-Perets, a place in the Desert:--Rimmon-parez.

H7429.def: a primitive root; to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively):--oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon).

H7430.def: a primitive root; properly, to glide swiftly, i.e. to crawl or move with short steps; by analogy to swarm:--creep, move.

H7431.def: from «07430»; a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal:--that creepeth, creeping (moving) thing.

H7432.def: from «07411»; height; Remeth, a place in Palestine:--Remeth.

H7433.def: or Ramoth Giliad (2 Chronicles 22:5) {raw-moth' gil-awd'}; from the plural of «07413» and «01568»; heights of Gilad; Ramoth-Gilad, a place East of the Jordan:--Ramoth-gilead, Ramoth in Gilead. See also «07216».

H7434.et: from (07413) and (04707) with the article interpolated
H7434.def: from «07413» and «04707» with the article interpolated; height of the watch-tower; Ramath-ham- Mitspeh, a place in Palestine:--Ramath-mizpeh.

H7435.def: patronymic of «07414»; a Ramathite or inhabitant of Ramah:--Ramathite.

H7436.et: from the dual of (07413) and the plural of the act part of (06822)
H7436.def: from the dual of «07413» and the plural of the active participle of «06822»; double height of watchers; Ramathajim-Tsophim, a place in Palestine:--Ramathaimzophim.

H7437.def: from «07413» and «03895»; height of a jaw-bone; Ramath-Lechi, a place in Palestine:--Ramath-lehi.

H7440.def: from «07442»; properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief):--cry, gladness, joy, proclamation, rejoicing, shouting, sing(-ing), triumph.

H7441.def: the same as «07440»; Rinnah, an Israelite:--Rinnah.

H7442.def: a primitive root; properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy):--aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.

H7443.def: from «07442»; an ostrich (from its wail):--X goodly.

H7445.def: from «07442»; a shout (for joy):--joyful (voice), singing, triumphing.

H7446.def: from «07450»; a ruin (as dripping to pieces); Rissah, a place in the Desert:--Rissah.

H7447.def: from «07450»; properly, dripping to pieces, i.e. a ruin; also a dew-drop:--breach, drop.

H7448.et: from an unused root meaning to curb
H7448.def: from an unused root meaning to curb; a halter (as restraining); by implication, the jaw:--bridle.

H7449.def: the same as «07448»; Resen, a place in Assyrian:--Resen.

H7450.def: a primitive root; to comminute; used only as denominative from «07447», to moisten (with drops):--temper.

H7451.def: from «07489»; bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral):-- adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, + displease(-ure), distress, evil((- favouredness), man, thing), + exceedingly, × great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), + mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, + not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).

H7452.def: from «07321»; a crash (of thunder), noise (of war), shout (of joy):--X aloud, noise, shouted.

H7453.def: or «0reya2» {ray'-ah}; from «07462»; an associate (more or less close):--brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, × (an-)other.

H7454.def: from «07462»; a thought (as association of ideas):--thought.

H7455.def: from «07489»; badness (as marring), physically or morally:--X be so bad, badness, (X be so) evil, naughtiness, sadness, sorrow, wickedness.

H7456.def: a primitive root; to hunger:--(suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger(-ry).

H7457.def: from «07456»; hungry (more or less intensely):--hunger bitten, hungry.

H7458.def: from «07456»; hunger (more or less extensive):--dearth, famine, + famished, hunger.

H7460.et: a primitive root, to shudder (more or less violently)
H7460.def: a primitive root: to shudder (more or less violently):--tremble.

H7462.def: a primitive root; to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend):--X break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep)(-er), pastor, + shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.

H7464.def: feminine of «07453»; a female associate:--companion, fellow.

H7466.def: for «07471» in the sense of «07453»; friend; Reu, a postdiluvian patriarch:--Reu.

H7467.def: from the same as «07466» and «0410»; friend of God; Reuel, the name of Moses' father-in-law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite:--Raguel, Reuel.

H7468.def: from «07462» in the sense of «07453»; a female associate; generally an additional one:--+ another, mate, neighbour.

H7469.def: probably from «07462»; a feeding upon, i.e. grasping after:--vexation.

H7473.def: from active participle of «07462»; pastoral; as noun, a shepherd:--shipherd.

H7474.def: feminine of «07453»; a female associate:--fellow, love.

H7475.def: from «07462» in the sense of «07469»; desire:--vexation.

H7476.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07475»; a grasp. i.e. (figuratively) mental conception:--cogitation, thought.

H7477.def: a primitive root; to reel, i.e. (figuratively) to brandish:--terribly shake.

H7479.def: feminine of «07478»; a long veil (as fluttering):--muffler.

H7480.def: from «07477» and «03050»; made to tremble (i.e. fearful) of Jah; Reelajah, an Israelite:--Reeliah.

H7481.def: a primitive root; to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger):--make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble.

H7483.def: feminine of «07482»; the mane of a horse (as quivering in the wind):--thunder.

H7484.def: the same as «07483»; Ramah, the name of a grandson of Ham, and of a place (perhaps founded by him):--Raamah.

H7485.def: from «07481» and «03050»; Jah has shaken; Raamjah, an Israelite:--Raamiah.

H7486.def: or Raamcec {rah-am-sace'}; of Egyptian origin; Rameses or Raamses, a place in Egypt:--Raamses, Rameses.

H7488.et: from an unused root meaning to be green
H7488.def: from an unused root meaning to be green; verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous:--green, flourishing.

H7489.def: a primitive root; properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good for nothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally):--afflict, associate selves (by mistake for «07462»), break (down, in pieces), + displease, (be, bring, do) evil (doer, entreat, man), show self friendly (by mistake for «07462»), do harm, (do) hurt, (behave self, deal) ill, × indeed, do mischief, punish, still, vex, (do) wicked (doer, -ly), be (deal, do) worse.

H7491.def: a primitive root; to drip:--distil, drop (down).

H7492.def: a primitive root; to break in pieces; figuratively, harass:--dash in pieces, vex.

H7493.def: a primitive root; to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), partic. through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust):--make afraid, (re-)move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble.

H7494.def: from «07493»; vibration, bounding, uproar:--commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking.

H7495.def: or raphah {raw-faw'}; a primitive root; properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure:--cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, × thoroughly, make whole. See «07503».

H7496.def: from «07495» in the sense of «07503»; properly, lax, i.e. (figuratively) a ghost (as dead; in plural only):--dead, deceased.

H7497.et: from (07495) in the sense of invigorating
H7497.def: or raphah {raw-faw'}; from «07495» in the sense of invigorating; a giant:--giant, Rapha, Rephaim(-s). See also «01051».

H7498.def: or Raphah {raw-faw'}; probably the same as «07497»; giant; Rapha or Raphah, the name of two Israelites:--Rapha.

H7499.def: feminine passive participle of «07495»; a medicament:--heal(-ed), medicine.
